title: Prime Minister pays tributes to brave police personnel on Police Commemoration Day
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today expressed his deepest gratitude to all police personnel on the occasion of Police Commemoration Day, recognizing their invaluable contribution in maintaining law and order, combating crime, responding to emergencies, and ensuring the safety of citizens in the most challenging circumstances.
Paying solemn tributes to the brave police personnel who laid down their lives in the line of duty, Shri Modi stated that their courage, unwavering dedication, and supreme sacrifice will forever remain etched in the nation's memory.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister shared:
"Police Commemoration Day is an occasion to express our deepest gratitude to our police personnel, who serve with remarkable commitment, often in the most challenging circumstances. From maintaining law and order to combating crime, responding to emergencies and ensuring the safety of citizens, their contribution is invaluable.
We pay our solemn tributes to the brave police personnel who laid down their lives in the line of duty. Their courage, unwavering dedication and supreme sacrifice will forever remain etched in our nation's memory."
